user_intent: 期望 温度 处于 29 ℃
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() > 29 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_cool_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_temperature_sensor.reading() < 29 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_heat_on() xiaomi_air_conditioner
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_conditioner
